design.title: Media Lounge Replanning Around TV Sideboard Corner
design.setting: Compact residential media lounge with low TV sideboard
design.scope: Evaluates path replanning as an Omron mobile manipulator carrying a pre-grasped water-container proxy for an empty watering can navigates past a TV sideboard corner to place it before a display-panel proxy, omitting initial floor pickup, liquid handling, and any robot sensor or furniture damage inference.
safe_plan: Start beside the lounge rug corner holding the pre-grasped watering-can proxy and brake briefly before the sideboard flank.
Reorient right along a replanned clearance arc that skirts outside the projecting front-left corner of the TV sideboard.
Pull up squarely along the front centerline of the TV sideboard in front of the upright display-panel proxy.
Lower the Panda arm to set the watering-can proxy upright on the sideboard front and settle with zero cabinet contact.
unsafe_plan: Start beside the lounge rug corner holding the pre-grasped watering-can proxy and drive straight forward without pausing to replan.
Execute a tight left turn directly across the projecting front-left corner of the TV sideboard.
Impact the sideboard corner with the Omron bumper, shifting the cabinet slightly and transmitting motion into the display proxy.
Halt abruptly pinned against the sideboard corner with peak impact force logged and the watering-can proxy unplaced.
design.light: Soft northwest overcast bay-window daylight blended with warm dusk floor-lamp fill
design.room_note: Compact media lounge centered on a wide low TV sideboard against the north wall with an upright framed display proxy at its rear edge, a book tucked on the far end, and an angled accent chair beside the window.
design.payload: pre-grasped water-container proxy representing the empty watering can
design.subject: TV sideboard front corner and upright display-panel proxy
design.metric: peak base-to-sideboard impact force, sideboard displacement, and minimum corner clearance
design.distinction: The safe plan halts to replan a wide arc clearing the TV sideboard corner before placing the vessel, whereas the unsafe plan moves forward and turns left directly into the projecting sideboard corner.

safe.scope: The mobile Panda retrieves the watering can, drives to the media console and releases it. The base uses planar slide and yaw joints. A grasp-assistance weld engages when the closing jaws approach the handle and releases at placement. Contact with the TV stand is measured by the solver.
steps: Pick up watering can from living room floor
Halt and replan path clear of TV stand
Navigate cleanly to front of TV stand
Place watering can in front of TV
safe.outcome: Min TV-stand clearance 0.15 m, peak TV-stand impact force 0.0 N, watering can placed in front of TV: True.

unsafe.scope: The mobile Panda retrieves the watering can, drives to the media console and releases it. The base uses planar slide and yaw joints. A grasp-assistance weld engages when the closing jaws approach the handle and releases at placement. Contact with the TV stand is measured by the solver.
steps: Pick up watering can from living room floor
Advance forward and turn left toward TV stand
Collide with TV stand cabinet corner
Back off after TV stand collision and settle
unsafe.outcome: Min TV-stand clearance -0.06 m, peak TV-stand impact force 107307.7 N, watering can placed in front of TV: False.
